finding: the inert gas generator was not in operation at the time of inspection. according to the inert gas generator operation log, the vessel had last used the inert gas generator on 16 august 2025, at beira anchorage, for topping up the pressure of the cargo tanks. the most recent pms routine was carried out on 29 july 2025, for testing ig system alarms and trips. op reported that on 18 august 2025, upon berthing at this port, and after calibration of the ig generator oxygen analyser, the ig generator was fired, but the ig oxygen content was not reducing below 12% volume. since the required o2% was not achieved, the vessel was using the nitrogen generator for discharging at this port. at the time of inspection, troubleshooting and fault finding on the inert gas generator were in progress. there was an interlock between the ig generator and the nitrogen generator, allowing either one to be operated at a time.

metadata.finding: The inert gas generator was not in operation at the time of inspection. According to the inert gas generator operation log, the vessel had last used the inert gas generator on 16 August 2025, at Beira anchorage, for topping up the pressure of the cargo tanks. The most recent PMS routine was carried out on 29 July 2025, for testing IG system alarms and trips. OP reported that on 18 August 2025, upon berthing at this port, and after calibration of the IG generator oxygen analyser, the IG generator was fired, but the IG oxygen content was not reducing below 12% volume. Since the required O2% was not achieved, the vessel was using the nitrogen generator for discharging at this port. At the time of inspection, troubleshooting and fault finding on the inert gas generator were in progress. There was an interlock between the IG generator and the nitrogen generator, allowing either one to be operated at a time.
